deviceTitle: Set up your computer and phone
deviceBody: Follow the guide for your device and import your subscription into a compatible VPN client. Your subscription details are in the same account when you switch devices.
chooseBody: Compare data allowances and billing periods when plans are available.
configureBody: Open your account for your subscription and setup instructions, then import it into your client.
manageBody: Sign in to see your data usage, expiration date, and subscription details.
vpnAnswer: A VPN creates an encrypted connection between your device and a VPN server. Once connected, your traffic can be routed through that server.
devicesQuestion: Do I need to install a client?
devicesAnswer: Usually, yes. Follow the setup guide for your device to choose a compatible client and import your GoodVPN subscription.
plansQuestion: Where can I see data limits and expiry dates?
plansAnswer: Available plans on the homepage show their data allowances and billing periods. After purchase, your subscription page shows usage and the actual expiration date.
helpQuestion: What if I need help setting up?
helpAnswer: Start with the setup guide for your device. If you still have trouble connecting, sign in and open a support ticket.
